from pathlib import Path
import struct
for p in Path('corpora').rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    data=p.read_bytes()
    pos=0; url=None; wc=None; sec=None; responses=[]; bad=False
    while pos+6<=len(data):
        t,l=struct.unpack('!HL', data[pos:pos+6]); pos+=6
        if pos+l>len(data): bad=True; break
        v=data[pos:pos+l]; pos+=l
        if t==1: url=v
        if t==33 and len(v)==4: wc=struct.unpack('!L',v)[0]
        if t==31: sec=v
    if url and b'ftp' in url and (wc or sec):
        print(p, 'size', len(data), 'url', url[:80], 'wc', wc, 'sec_len', len(sec) if sec else None, 'sec_preview', repr(sec[:100]) if sec else '')
